$comment: FIT-11 state-machine writer registry. A domain UPDATE is legal only when its writer is listed in the rule's allowed_files (the police service split p0/p1/p2_system/p3_cases) or when the exact (writer, table, file, function) tuple is registered in entries with a reason and an expiry. entries are a debt register: expired or unused entries fail. Other resources (custom-justice, custom-phone, qb-prison) must go through a custom-police export; they may not write police state directly. Checked by tests/architecture/test_state_writers.py.

rules.reason: police_units.status/incident_id 是 SM-01 单位状态机；唯一写入口是 p0 的 duty/incident helper（syncDuty、assignUnitRow、markIncidentUnits、releaseIncidentUnits、takeUnitOffDuty）。
police_incidents.status 是 SM-02 警情状态机；唯一写入口是 p0 的 AssignUnit / SetIncidentStatus / releaseDroppedUnit / SweepStaleIncidents。
报告锚点由 p1（CreateReport）、p2_system（ArrestSubmit 链接与回滚）和 p3_cases（RecordVerdict 判决投影）维护。
案件号回填只在 CreateCase（p3）与 ArrestSubmit 的补偿路径（p2_system）。
罚单状态 unpaid→paid 与支付回滚只在 p1.PayCitation；其他资源只能读或用 phone 的罚单接口。
BOLO active→cleared 只在 p3_cases.ClearBolo；表本身已是 FIT-12 弃用登记对象，不允许新增写者。
